fact: The Ministry of Communications and Technology's e-Government Strategy 2025-2029 states that the Federal Government of Somalia still has no enterprise architecture or interoperability framework, leaving digital government initiatives fragmented in silos; the statement carries no day, so the document's published date (2025-08) is used.

Somalia's Office of the Prime Minister and Ministry of Communications and Technology held a national workshop on 27 October 2026 to validate the National Digital Coordination Framework for federal government digital systems.
